summary: Nora notices an edit when she re-reads the room, and can tell whether her reply came before or after it.
details: Re-reading older messages now shows which ones were edited and what they first said; before, an edited message looked unchanged there.
Asking who said something now also finds words that were in a message before its sender edited them.
An edited message now names the last message sent before the edit, so a reply to the old version is recognisable even when both happened within the same minute.
limitations: @-mentions in re-read Signal messages still show as a placeholder rather than a name.
